definitions.explanation: The academic department at a university that covers the natural sciences such as physics, chemistry, biology, and mathematics.

examples.japanese: {理学部|りがくぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{物理|ぶつり}→物理：03609_butsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I am studying physics in the faculty of science.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理学部|りがくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{化学科|かがくか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: My younger brother went into the chemistry department in the faculty of science.

examples.japanese: {理学部|りがくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実験室|じっけんしつ}→実験室：25411_jikkenshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学部|がくぶ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。
examples.english: The science faculty building is larger than other faculties because it has many laboratories.

notes:
A compound of {理|り} (science/reason) and {学部|がくぶ} (faculty). Covers pure sciences as opposed to ⟦{工学部|こうがくぶ}→工学部：24493_kougakubu⟧ (engineering), which focuses on applied sciences. Some universities combine them as {理工学部|りこうがくぶ} (faculty of science and engineering).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理学部|りがくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧: science faculty professor
- {理学部|りがくぶ}{数学科|すうがくか}: mathematics department (within science)
- {理学部|りがくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{志望|しぼう}→志望：03200_shibou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to aspire to the science faculty

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{工学部|こうがくぶ}→工学部：24493_kougakubu⟧: faculty of engineering
- {理工学部|りこうがくぶ}: faculty of science and engineering (combined)
- ⟦{理学|りがく}→理学：28867_rigaku⟧: science (the discipline)
- {学部|がくぶ}: faculty; department
